entities.summary: Sara Sorribes Tormo is a Spanish professional tennis player. She has a career-high WTA singles ranking of world No. 32 achieved on 7 February 2022 and a best doubles ranking of No. 17, reached on 6 May 2024. Her most notable result is a bronze medal in the women's doubles at the 2024 Summer Olympics, with Cristina Bucșa.
